**Failures, remaining criteria and proposed corrections.** No new blocking frozen physics/command/save defect was reproduced in the implemented fixture paths. The following limits remain explicit:

- **Designated mobile-refuge fallback is unexecuted.** M1 `PlayerState.refugeId` accepts registry `PlaceId`; `PLACES` contains no carrier/mobile registration, and there is no corresponding normal control. The two drills prove pod fallback from interior and from a now-disabled carrier, but cannot prove loss of a *registered* mobile refuge. Minimal reproduction: inspect the fixture/notebook/control set and `src/sim/types.ts:31`, `src/content/registry.ts:114`, `src/sim/recovery.ts:66`; no supported registration exists. Root must retain this criterion as open until the intended registration/unsafe-refuge mechanism is implemented and normally exercised; no hidden schema extension is proposed here.
- **Full-path mid-throat geometry blockers are diagnostic-only.** The browser proved supported obstruction-flag rollback and genuine other-craft capture obstruction/clearance. No ordinary player tool places a thin solid inside the throat. The existing 26-test subset provides the full-path endpoint-clear/changed-obstruction geometry proof; it does not become a browser placement pass.
- **Baseline render mismatch remains root-owned.** Root reported and independently confirmed the hull/carrier-shell `+savedYaw` presentation sign versus required Babylon `-savedYaw`. This run's nonzero-heading scenes use yaw 6.108185; shell/physical alignment cannot be accepted from them. Numeric local/world transforms and transfer identities remain independently useful. Root's concurrent render correction was not read/copied/waited on. Opaque windows, bright deep surface and absent cockpit also remain attributed to this baseline. From close Creel/Spindle boarding distance, the camera is occluded by hull geometry while the E prompt is usable; those captures establish control access, not visual readability acceptance. Root must recheck final composed presentation/alignment.
- **Excluded operator attempts are retained.** A direct compact return stopped at a room instead of reaching the bridge; a direct medium route similarly met a closed room. Later ordinary starboard-waypoint traversal/return completed. Early retreat/contact probes left station keeping enabled and are excluded from active movement proof; the later `f0-collision-controlled` and `f0-real-dock-return-*` use helm control and replace them. Out-of-range capture/vestibule/reconfigure attempts are refusals, not missing mechanisms.
- One three-segment evaluation exceeded the preview **15,000 ms** limit. It completed around the interruption boundary; the page was blurred, held keys released and its recording stopped. Its 25.70 s clip is excluded. Later single-segment bounded contact/retreat checks provide the successful evidence. An early F1 evaluation exceeded the **64 KiB result limit** after executing its actions; those unretrieved snapshot results are excluded and the bounded retest retained per-action snapshots. No timed-out control loop remains running. These are harness/operator failures, not production fixes.
